identity_notes: A dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist peptide. FDA has approved it as the active ingredient in Mounjaro and Zepbound for specific indications, routes, strengths, and products.

status_assertions.qualification: Mounjaro (tirzepatide) injection approved 2022-05-13 for T2D; Zepbound (tirzepatide) injection approved 2023-11-08 for chronic weight management.
FDA determined the tirzepatide injection shortage was resolved on 2024-12-19. Localized supply disruptions may still occur.

status_assertions.status_label: Copy restrictions apply after shortage resolution
status_assertions.qualification: Compounded drugs that are essentially copies of Mounjaro/Zepbound are generally restricted under 503A now that the shortage is resolved. FDA's 60/90-day enforcement-discretion period has ended.

timeline.title: FDA approves Mounjaro
timeline.description: Approved for glycemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes.

timeline.title: FDA resolves tirzepatide shortage
timeline.description: Declaratory order ends shortage status and limits compounding-copy exceptions.
